title: Best Abs Exercises: Science-Based Core Training That Delivers Results
summary: Ab-wheel rollout is described as one of the most challenging anti-extension exercises and reserved for intermediate/advanced clients with sufficient trunk stability and body awareness.

title: Bodyweight Squat
summary: ACE rates bodyweight squat Beginner and documents bracing, controlled hip/knee motion, alignment, and parallel-depth execution.

title: Bird Dog
summary: Opposite arm/leg extension requires anti-rotation core stability and coordinated movement; ACE rates Bird-dog Intermediate.

title: CrossFit chest-to-bar pull-up guidance
summary: CrossFit states chest-to-bar is significantly more difficult than a traditional pull-up because of ROM and references prerequisite strength, movement precision, and shoulder-extension ROM.

title: Cat-Cow
summary: ACE rates Cat-Cow Beginner and documents controlled spinal flexion/extension from quadruped with gentle core bracing.

title: Beginner Pistol Squat Progressions
summary: High-box pistol squat is an early progression requiring controlled single-leg descent; related guidance identifies balance and ankle mobility as explicit limiters.

title: Bear Crawl Exercise
summary: ACE rates Bear Crawl Intermediate and specifies alternating contralateral arm/leg movement while maintaining trunk/hip/shoulder alignment.

title: Dead Bug
summary: NASM describes Dead Bug as accessible for all fitness levels, developing anti-extension core strength and coordinated opposite-limb movement.

title: Childs Pose
summary: ACE rates Child's Pose Beginner and describes a supported kneeling hip hinge/fold emphasizing spinal length and controlled positioning.

title: Cobra Exercise
summary: ACE rates Cobra Beginner and describes controlled trunk extension/stretch with hips supported on the floor.

title: Chin-ups
summary: ACE rates Chin-ups Intermediate and requires controlled bodyweight pulling to chin-over-bar with trunk stabilization and no swinging.

title: Forward Lunge
summary: ACE rates Forward Lunge Intermediate, explicitly requires single-leg stabilization before stepping, controlled lowering, alignment, and return.

title: Front Plank
summary: ACE rates Front Plank Intermediate and requires sustained trunk stiffness and aligned body position while supporting bodyweight.

title: Farmer's Carry
summary: ACE rates Farmer's Carry Intermediate and describes loaded walking with a straight back over a prescribed distance.

title: Raised Platform/Box Exercise Library
summary: ACE classifies Box Jumps as Intermediate; the exercise is a dynamic jump onto a raised platform.

title: Ab Wheel Exercises progression guide
summary: Late standing-eccentric progression immediately before full standing rollout; controlled standing descent.

title: Crunch
summary: ACE classifies Crunch as Beginner with controlled supine spinal flexion.

title: Foam Roll Adductors
summary: Appropriate for all fitness levels with body supported by the hands.

title: Advanced Tuck Back Lever
summary: Requires prior controlled tuck back lever and sustained straight-arm lever strength.

title: Assisted Pistol Squat
summary: Most accessible pistol progression: full-ROM single-leg squat using arms/support for assistance, progressively reduced.

title: Assisted Pull-up
summary: Band assistance preserves the standard pull-up movement pattern while reducing required force; assistance is adjusted to current strength.

title: Australian Pull-Up
summary: Low-difficulty scalable horizontal pull with heels supported; body angle adjusts load while trunk maintains a rigid line.

title: Back Lever
summary: Elite straight-arm horizontal skill; final position in a long progression, with substantial straight-arm load, demanding shoulder extension and strict body-line control.

title: Assisted Hamstring Curl
summary: Assisted Nordic-style curl uses upper-body support to regulate difficulty; prescribed as a low-rep strength progression.

title: Assisted Leg Raise
summary: Library classifies Assisted Leg Raise as Intermediate; supported lying execution trains hip flexors/quadriceps and core pattern.

title: Assisted Single-Leg Squat
summary: Suspension trainer assists balance, squat depth and thigh load during a controlled single-leg squat.

title: Back Extension Apparatus
summary: ACE notes back extensions can use bodyweight, dumbbells or machine and are appropriate for healthy adults of all fitness levels.

title: Bulgarian Split Squat
summary: Advanced unilateral lower-body movement explicitly challenging single-leg strength, balance and stability.

title: Back Lever Pullout
summary: Advanced transition from horizontal back lever to inverted hang with straight elbows and rigid body line.

title: Back Squat
summary: ACE classifies barbell Back Squat as Advanced and requires controlled below-knee depth with straight back and chest up.

title: Stability Ball Bridge
summary: Supine bridge with heels on a stability ball; hips rise while the unstable ball increases stabilization demand.

title: Ball Shoulder Stretch
summary: Supported kneeling stretch rolling an exercise ball forward only to a comfortable gentle shoulder/upper-back stretch.

title: Band-Assisted Planche
summary: Band reduces load but preserves planche body line; assistance is progressively reduced toward unassisted planche.

title: Banded Biceps Curl
summary: Beginner resistance-band isolation curl with fixed elbows and controlled return.

title: Banded Chest Press
summary: Beginner-friendly seated resistance-band press; simple bilateral compound push.

title: Banded Deadlift
summary: Band-resisted barbell deadlift requires coordinated hip/knee extension, neutral spine and increasing lockout resistance.

title: Banded Rear Delt Row
summary: Standing anchored-band high-elbow row targeting rear delts and upper back with controlled return.

title: Band External Rotation
summary: Beginner prehab/rehab rotator-cuff movement using light resistance and fixed elbow.

title: Banded Front Raise
summary: Included in a beginner shoulder workout; controlled standing band raise to eye level.

title: Banded Lateral Raise
summary: Beginner isolation shoulder exercise performed standing on a band with controlled raise/lower.

title: Banded Lying Leg Extension
summary: Supine band-resisted alternating leg extension with core braced and controlled range.

title: Band Triceps Extension
summary: Beginner elbow-extension isolation drill with controlled upper-arm position.

title: Banded Unilateral Triceps Extension
summary: Single-arm band triceps extension with stable staggered stance and isolated elbow extension.

title: Banded Upright Row
summary: Beginner resistance-band strength exercise: stand on band and pull to upper chest.

title: Bar Pull-Up Eccentrics
summary: Progression immediately before strict pull-up; requires repeated controlled ~5-second negative lowers.

title: Barbell Bent Leg Dead Lift
publisher: Anatomy for Strength and Fitness Training
summary: Compound closed-chain barbell pull classified intermediate to advanced, requiring coordinated knee/hip extension.

title: Barbell Biceps Curl
summary: ACE barbell library classifies Bicep Curl as Intermediate.

title: Barbell Glute Bridge
summary: Weighted progression of bodyweight glute bridge; stable floor-supported hip extension with adjustable load.

title: Standing Shoulder Press
summary: ACE classifies standing barbell shoulder press as Advanced; requires standing bracing and controlled overhead press.

title: Barbell Row
summary: ACE describes barbell row as Advanced and notes core stabilization demand.

title: Barbell Shrug
summary: Catalog difficulty 2/5; simple standing barbell shrug with controlled vertical shoulder movement.

title: Standing Shoulder Press
summary: ACE classifies standing barbell shoulder press as Advanced.

title: Behind-the-Neck Press
summary: Requires substantial shoulder extension/abduction and stability; even advanced lifters are advised to use care.

title: Behind-the-Neck Pull-Up
summary: Advanced bodyweight pull requiring unusual shoulder rotation range and controlled hanging execution.

title: Bench Dips
summary: Intermediate bodyweight triceps exercise; scalable with foot position and requires controlled shoulder positioning.

title: Barbell Bench Press
summary: Standard loaded chest press used as benchmark in ACE chest-exercise research; stable bench-supported compound press.

title: Bend and Reach
summary: Slow preparation drill developing squat-and-reach ability and moving hips/spine through full flexion.

title: Bent-Arm Bent-Body Press to Handstand
summary: Structured gymnastics progression lists this as Level 5 bent-arm press-to-handstand skill.

title: Bent Arm Pull Up to Back Lever
summary: Explicitly classified Advanced in the back-lever progression after back lever/pullout.

title: Bent-Arm Straight-Body Press to Handstand
summary: Structured gymnastics progression lists bent-arm straight-body press to handstand as Level 8.

title: Bent Knee Push-up
summary: ACE classifies the kneeling push-up as Beginner.

title: Bent-Knee Sit-Up
summary: Classic floor core exercise using controlled trunk/hip flexion from a stable supine base.

title: Bent-Over Lateral Raise
summary: Intermediate rear-deltoid isolation exercise requiring a stable hip-hinged torso and controlled raise.

title: Bent-Over One-Arm Dumbbell Row
summary: Basic fundamental supported unilateral row with torso kept motionless.

title: Bent-over Row
summary: ACE classifies barbell bent-over row as Advanced and requires maintained flat-back hip hinge.

title: Bicycle Crunch
summary: Bodyweight core movement combining trunk rotation/flexion with alternating leg motion.

title: Bear Crawls
summary: ACE places bear crawls in bodyweight performance training, requiring coordinated quadrupedal locomotion.

title: Bastards
summary: Progression beyond a difficult burpee combining squat thrust, full push-up and explosive tuck jump; described as very hard full-body exercise.

title: Bench Step
summary: Alternating bench step-up targets quads, hamstrings and glutes and explicitly improves balance.

title: Bent Leg Good Morning
publisher: Anatomy for Strength and Fitness Training
summary: Barbell bent-leg good morning is explicitly classified intermediate to advanced and uses a controlled hip hinge.

title: Bodyweight/Air Squat
summary: ACE bodyweight interval guidance places air squats in an entry-level muscular-endurance workout.

title: Box Dip
summary: Stable box-supported bodyweight dip: hands fixed behind body, lower to about 90-degree elbows, press back up.

title: Box Headstand Pushup
summary: Level-2 handstand-pushup progression; feet elevation shifts more bodyweight onto hands and requires prior solid pike headstand pushup.

title: Burpees
summary: High-intensity full-body sequence combining squat, plank, push-up and explosive jump; seven familiar movements but substantial strength/cardio demand.
